title: Interior Permanent-Work Payment Computation, Utility Line Protection Plans
content:
# Interior Permanent-Work Payment Computation

Claims Finance computation note for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, permanent work on interior supply and drain lines.

## The calculation

The interior permanent-work payment is figured once, on the day it is booked and from the plan's records as they stand that day; periods said to run to the request date end on the service request's request date. The interior permanent-work payment is the interior occurrence benefit left open on the service request: the plan's interior plumbing occurrence cap less every amount already authorized on the service request, net of reversals, never below zero. The interior permanent-work payment is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Inputs

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| Interior plumbing occurrence cap | a figure of the plan held |
| Amounts already authorized on the service request | every authorization in the claim history on that request, allowances included |
| Reversals | reversals in the claim history of authorizations on that request |
| Request date | the service request record |

## The steps in order

1. Add up every amount already authorized on the service request, whatever the item: repairs, temporary repairs and allowances.
2. Take away the amounts reversed on that request, giving the net amount authorized.
3. Take the net amount from the plan's interior plumbing occurrence cap; where the result is below zero, it is zero.
4. Round the result to the cent. That is the interior permanent-work payment.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures, not plan values)

Assume an interior plumbing occurrence cap of $2500.00.

| Authorized on the request | Reversed | Net | Payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| nothing | nothing | $0.00 | $2500.00 |
| $350.00 temporary repair and $400.00 allowance | nothing | $750.00 | $1750.00 |
| $350.00 temporary repair and $400.00 allowance | $350.00 | $400.00 | $2100.00 |
| $2600.00 | nothing | $2600.00 | $0.00 |
